name: video-downloader
description: Download videos and audio from YouTube and 1,000+ other sites with yt-dlp into a library you can use in any project.

gallery.caption: Your downloads in the sidebar, ready for any project; the downloader tab beside it
Paste a link, pick a format by its size, and it downloads straight into your project
Every format with its size on the right; Downloads and yt-dlp's log below
Downloaded media remembers where it came from: the Source section in the Inspector

tools.name: get_info
tools.description: Look up a video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, X, TikTok, Instagram and 1,000+ sites supported by yt-dlp) without downloading: title, channel, duration, upload date, available resolutions and a description excerpt. Use it to check you have the right video before downloading.

url.description: The video page URL (http or https).

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a video (or just its audio) from a URL into the user's video library (Downloads/AnyCut/Video Downloader) and, when a project is open, copy it into the project and add it to the media. Optionally only a section (start/end in seconds) — use that for reference clips. Returns the file path and media id. Only download what the user asked for; mind copyright and the site's terms.

url.description: The video page URL (http or https).

quality.description: Maximum height, or 'audio' for an audio-only MP3. Default 1080.

start.description: Only download from this second (needs end).

end.description: Only download up to this second.

addToProject.description: Also copy it into the open project and add it to the media (default true).

subfolder.title: Project folder
subfolder.description: Where downloads are copied when added to a project: a folder inside its import folder (empty = the import folder itself). Every download also stays in Downloads/AnyCut/Video Downloader.

ytdlpPath.title: yt-dlp path
ytdlpPath.description: Use this yt-dlp executable instead of the one on PATH or the one installed here.
